task.description:
Design and add test specifications/cases for OIDC-27 through OIDC-34 based on implemented artifacts from Step 02. Cover unit and integration surfaces and ensure MUST requirements have executable coverage plans.

Required outputs:
- tests/specs/OIDC-27.md through tests/specs/OIDC-34.md (or consolidated spec that maps each requirement unambiguously)
- Any required test-source additions/updates in tests/unit and tests/integration for uncovered paths

Coverage priorities:
- OIDC-31 must verify end-to-end auth flows against real backend + DB + IDP setup path
- OIDC-33 must include coexistence-path acceptance conditions
- OIDC-28/29/30/32/34 must include tooling/seed/migration helper behavior checks
- OIDC-27 should include measurable verification-performance assertion boundaries

No mocking shortcuts for integration requirements; align with test guide directives.
acceptance_criteria: Each OIDC-27..34 requirement is mapped to explicit test cases
MUST requirements include executable test paths
Specs reference concrete test files and commands
Test plan reflects real-environment constraints for OIDC-31
No unresolved ambiguity on pass/fail conditions

result.summary: Test specs and executable test-source coverage were added for OIDC-27 through OIDC-34, including unit coverage for local realm and agent identity artifacts, integration preflight for OIDC-31 real backend+DB+IDP path, and integration candidate-list coverage for OIDC-34 migration helper behavior.
